analyst.summary: Godrej Properties just posted its best-ever year: record pre-sales (Rs 34,171 Cr, +16%), record profit (Rs 1,850 Cr, +32%), and a huge land-bank addition (Rs 42,100 Cr of new business development, more than double its target) that sets up a bigger FY27 launch pipeline. The balance sheet took on more debt to fund that land-buying spree (net debt nearly doubled) but leverage is still conservative in relative terms, and cash collections from customers grew but missed the company's own target slightly -- a detail worth watching. Management is guiding to about 14% more pre-sales in FY27 and an ambitious near-doubling of return on equity by FY28. The stock trades at a rich ~35x trailing earnings and 3.4x book value, pricing in a good chunk of that ambition already. We rate this a Hold: nothing is broken operationally -- in fact execution has been excellent -- but the valuation leaves little room for the growth deceleration already visible in the guidance numbers (14% next year vs a much faster multi-year run before this) to disappoint further.
